verified_fact: Hiranyakashipu got a boon: cannot be killed by man or animal, inside or outside, day or night, on earth or sky, with any weapon. voiceover_script: Hiranyakashipu ne Brahma se ek aisi vardaan maangi ki koi usse maar nahi sakta! Na insaan, na janwar, na din mein, na raat mein, na zameen par, na aasman mein, na andar na bahar, na kisi hatyar se. Lagbhag amar! Par Vishnu ne loophole nahi choda. Narasimha roop — aadha insaan aadha sher. Sandhy kaal — na din na raat. Drwaar par — na andar na bahar. Godi mein — na zameen na aasman. Naakhoon — na hatyar. Har condition poori!
debate_question: Itne sare loopholes — Hiranyakashipu ne chook kaise ki?
pinned_comment: 🦁 Narasimha — har loophole band! Prahlad ki bhakti ne baap ko haraaya! Jai Hari!
